purpose: Teach: 挙式/原宿/マフィア/マドリード/ハローワーク/フェラーリ/軽井沢/種子

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとお母さんの挙式の写真、見せて頂いたわ
lines.en: Sho, I saw the most beautiful photos from your parents' wedding.
lines.style: Warm, gentle nostalgia. Voice settles into a soft smile. Slow, lingering pace. Speaking to a child about something precious, with tenderness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと原宿に行きたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to go to Harajuku with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, excited burst. Open vowels on 'want'. Quick tempo, bouncing energy. The eagerness of a six-year-old who can't quite contain his happiness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがマフィア映画を観てらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father was watching a mafia film the other day.
lines.style: Observant, gently amused. Light, conversational tone. A small smile underneath—noticing something about him. Even pace, warm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、マドリードの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw a picture book about Madrid!
lines.style: Quick, proud announcement. Slight lift on 'Madrid'—wants to share something he found interesting. Still energetic but more focused than chaotic.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがハローワークのお仕事のお話して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father told me about his work at the employment agency.
lines.style: Thoughtful, attentive listening in the voice. Gentle emphasis on 'told me'—he shared something. Slow enough to let the care show. Interested, not performing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、フェラーリの模型作ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I made a Ferrari model!
lines.style: Proud, direct announcement. Slight breathiness on the 'a'—he's showing something he worked on. Natural child confidence, not loud but certain.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが軽井沢に連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father is taking you to Karuizawa soon, isn't he?
lines.style: Warm anticipation in the voice. Gentle lift at the end—a statement that invites him to be excited. Slow, savoring pace. Like she's already happy for him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとお花の種子を蒔いたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad and I planted flower seeds together!
lines.style: Excited but grounded—pride in something shared. Warm energy, not frantic. The natural contentment of a child who did something with someone he loves. Slight trailing joy.
